_doc: The SDK versions Cua claims to support, in one place. `pinned` is what PR CI and the examples suite run; `claimed` lists every version with a committed fixture or a passing run; the weekly drift workflow (compat-drift.yml) also tests the latest release of each package. libs/cua/tests/compat/<provider>/PINNED must equal py.pinned (examples/run.py lint checks it). Provider agents: add a version to `claimed` only with a fixture and a green run.

ts.note: surface fixture only (modal npm 0.11.1); the gateway targets the Python SDK
